title: Local log: 3 pulses + visual warp
description: At 02:19 the security cam shows a brief warping of the tree line followed by three distinct low-frequency pulses. No audio on mic but felt in chest.

title: Personal account: mirror reflection was wrong
description: My reflection smiled half a second before I did. Happened twice in the same mirror at home. No one else saw it.

title: Hiker report: path that shouldn't exist
description: Followed a trail for 12 minutes that terminated at a clearing with a stone arch. Returning the same way took 4 minutes and the arch was gone.
